summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K announcing preliminary Q2 2026 results and disclosed the acquisition of foundational solar patents and intellectual property rights from Evervolt Green Energy Holding Pte Ltd for $135 million total consideration. No price per share or premium is applicable; the deal terms are asset-based. The filing includes preliminary financials: net sales $245-$255 million, net loss $34-$37 million, and cash of $156.4 million. The acquisition is a strategic expansion into solar IP, though details are in a separate release. Watch for integration execution and potential financing needs given restricted cash position.
